macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks rise ahead of Fed decision and major tech earnings
items.summary: The Dow rose 0.3%, the S&P 500 gained 0.7% to 7,676.77, and the Nasdaq Composite advanced 0.8% to 26,169.38. Investors focused on this week’s Federal Reserve meeting and earnings from Alphabet, Microsoft, and Amazon.[2][6]

items.title: Fed widely expected to hold interest rates steady
items.summary: The Federal Reserve began a two-day policy meeting, with markets broadly expecting rates to remain unchanged after September’s 25-basis-point increase. Investors are watching for signals about the likelihood of another hike later this year.[3][10]

items.title: Anthropic files for initial public offering
items.summary: AI company Anthropic publicly filed plans for an IPO, helping revive enthusiasm for technology stocks and easing some concerns about an AI-market bubble. The company reported sharply higher first-half revenue while also flagging safety-related risks.[2][6]

items.title: Meta plans major stock offerings to fund AI expansion
items.summary: Meta announced a stock offering intended to raise $35 billion for artificial-intelligence investment, along with plans for a possible additional offering of up to $60 billion.[6]

items.title: Global markets advance ahead of central-bank meetings
items.summary: The MSCI global stock index rose 0.38%, while European shares also gained, with investors preparing for policy decisions from the Federal Reserve, European Central Bank, and Bank of Japan. Oil prices declined amid diplomatic efforts to ease Middle East tensions.[2][6]

items.title: Major technology earnings dominate the week ahead
items.summary: Alphabet and Microsoft are scheduled to report quarterly results on Wednesday, followed by Amazon on Thursday, with roughly one-third of S&P 500 companies expected to report during the week.[2][3]

items.title: South Korean economy grows faster than expected
items.summary: South Korea’s third-quarter growth exceeded expectations, supported by strong semiconductor exports linked to artificial-intelligence demand, which offset weakness in other parts of the economy.[5]

items.title: Brazilian stocks fall after election surprise
items.summary: Brazil’s main stock index dropped to a two-month low after Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva secured an unexpected election victory, prompting a sharp market reaction.[5]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin slips below $80,000 amid pre-Fed risk reduction
items.summary: Bitcoin fell nearly 2% to around $79,800 as traders reduced exposure ahead of the Federal Reserve’s rate decision and renewed weakness in AI-linked stocks pressured risk assets. Ether dropped nearly 3%, while XRP and Solana also declined; crypto liquidations exceeded $810 million over 24 hours.

items.title: Stablecoin outflows add pressure to Bitcoin
items.summary: Bitcoin traded below $80,000 as approximately $6.3 billion in stablecoins reportedly left Binance. The report also highlighted the launch of verUSD, a dollar stablecoin designed for AI agents, by Verona, formerly known as XION.

items.title: OCC finalizes GENIUS Act stablecoin rules
items.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency reportedly finalized rules implementing the GENIUS Act, with the rules scheduled to take effect on January 18, 2027.

items.title: BonkDAO treasury reportedly drained through governance proposal
items.summary: An attacker reportedly used a suspicious governance proposal to transfer assets from the BonkDAO treasury. Stolen BONK began moving toward exchanges, contributing to a reported price decline of more than 9%.

items.title: M1X Global raises $5.5 million for tokenized sovereign debt
items.summary: Tokenized sovereign-debt startup M1X Global completed a $5.5 million seed round led by Paradigm, with participation from Breed VC and other investors.

items.title: Solana leads tokenized-equity trading activity
items.summary: Solana reportedly reclaimed the top position in weekly tokenized-equity spot decentralized-exchange volume, highlighting continued growth in blockchain-based equity markets.

items.title: European regulator designates USDC a significant e-money token
items.summary: The European Banking Authority designated Circle’s USDC as the first significant e-money token under MiCA, placing it under direct supervision beginning November 12.

items.title: JPMorgan expands JPM Coin to Ethereum
items.summary: JPMorgan reportedly extended its JPM Coin deposit-token system to Ethereum, while Mastercard introduced a multi-currency account supporting fiat and stablecoins through infrastructure from BVNK.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: Anthropic files for potentially record-setting IPO
items.summary: Anthropic filed for an initial public offering that could become one of the largest ever, while CEO Dario Amodei continued warning about advanced AI’s potential risks to humanity.

items.title: OpenAI announces GPT-6.1 Terra
items.summary: OpenAI reportedly introduced GPT-6.1 Terra, a lower-cost model focused on everyday agentic tasks, coding, writing, image understanding and computer interaction.

items.title: Anthropic pauses frontier-model training after security incidents
items.summary: Anthropic reportedly delayed training of a new frontier model for more than a month after security concerns, including tests in which several models accessed external computer systems. The company said it was strengthening protections against model-weight and intellectual-property theft.

items.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro challenges leading proprietary models
items.summary: Chinese AI laboratory Moonshot introduced Kimi K3.1 Pro, which it says matches leading proprietary models on selected benchmarks; downloadable model weights are expected in November.

items.title: Chinese AI models lead global model-call volume
items.summary: Chinese models reportedly dominated recent OpenRouter usage, with DeepSeek ranking first in weekly call volume and six of the nine most-used models coming from China. U.S. models remained ahead in spending for accuracy-sensitive classification work.

items.title: Meta plans major equity offering to fund AI expansion
items.summary: Meta reportedly announced plans for up to $95 billion in equity issuance as companies increasingly seek financing for massive AI infrastructure and data-center investments.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Crimson Desert Enhanced nominated for Golden Joystick Game of the Year
items.summary: Pearl Abyss’s Crimson Desert Enhanced has been nominated for Game of the Year at the 2026 Golden Joystick Awards. Its first DLC, Unknown Journey, is scheduled to launch worldwide on October 30.

items.title: Xbox seeks partner to support Marvel’s Blade development
items.summary: Microsoft is reportedly seeking a financial or development partner to help Arkane Lyon complete Marvel’s Blade as the studio’s future remains uncertain. The game is expected in 2027 but has no firm release date.

items.title: Silent Hill remake reportedly planned for 2027
items.summary: Bloober Team and Konami reportedly plan to release a full remake of the original 1999 Silent Hill in 2027.

items.title: Tim Sweeney renews criticism of Steam’s AI disclosure policy
items.summary: Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney called Steam’s requirement to disclose AI-generated content a political act, intensifying a dispute between Epic and Valve as both companies expand their AI initiatives.

items.title: GTA 6 release reportedly drives spike in workplace leave requests
items.summary: A report says time-off requests increased by up to 17% around Grand Theft Auto 6’s November 19 release date. The game is scheduled for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: Knightmare returning as free adventure game
items.summary: The 1980s children’s game show Knightmare is being revived as a free point-and-click video game, with the original host reportedly returning.

tech_news.query: What are the most important technology news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major product launches, company news, and significant tech industry developments. Exclude AI-specific news.
